_readme: Each line has 'game' (shown in Minecraft chat) and 'tg' (sent to Telegram). 'tg' is optional; if missing, 'game' is used. To add a line, write only the text fields and leave 'used' out. Telegram messages follow the tone of the in-game ones. This version: every line within a category uses a different template and sarcasm type, and Telegram text is written per line. When adding a new line, pick a template that isn't already used in the category.
